aboutPanel.title: About
aboutPanel.tagline: Professional PDF editing, free and open source.
aboutPanel.description: View, annotate, edit, and manage PDF documents with a full-featured editor built on open standards. No subscriptions, no license fees, no vendor lock-in.
aboutPanel.companyDescription: Developing, supporting, and promoting open source software for the construction industry and beyond. Transparent pricing, transparent code.
aboutPanel.license: Licensed under MIT. Free for personal and commercial use.

importPanel.importXfdfDesc: Import annotations from an XFDF file into the current document
importPanel.importBcfDesc: Import BCF topics from another BIM tool as annotations
importPanel.importCadDesc: Import a DWG or DXF drawing as a PDF page to scale, with layers and a measuring scale

exportPanel.title: Export
exportPanel.exportImagesDesc: Save pages as PNG or JPEG image files
exportPanel.exportRasterDesc: Flatten pages and annotations into a new PDF with rasterized images
exportPanel.exportXfdfDesc: Export all annotations to an XFDF file for sharing or backup
exportPanel.exportBcfDesc: Export annotations as BCF 2.1 topics for other BIM tools
exportPanel.exportPdfxDesc: Create a print-ready PDF/X file with an output intent and metadata
exportPanel.pdfxNote: Adds an output intent, TrimBox and PDF/X metadata. With a CMYK printing profile, RGB colours, images and gradients are converted to CMYK and that profile becomes the output intent; with sRGB nothing is converted. Standard fonts that are not embedded remain a limitation.
exportPanel.exportCadDesc: Export the vector drawing to DXF or DWG, with layers, scale and area

pdfxCmyk.noneFound: No CMYK printing profiles found in the system colour folder
pdfxCmyk.help: For CMYK printing, choose the printing profile (.icc or .icm) of your print shop: ask them for it, or use a freely available profile set from a printing industry association. Profiles installed in the system colour folder appear in this list automatically.
pdfxCmyk.intentRelative: Relative colorimetric with black point compensation
pdfxCmyk.invalidProfile: “{{file}}” cannot be used as a CMYK printing profile: {{reason}}

profileReasons.notIcc: it is not an ICC colour profile.
profileReasons.notCmyk: its colour space is not CMYK.
profileReasons.notPrinter: it is not an output (printer) profile.

pdfxCmyk.convertingPages: Converting colours to CMYK… page {{done}} of {{total}}

failReasons.transform: the profile cannot be used for a colour conversion.

pdfxCmyk.reportTitle: PDF/X saved. Colours converted to CMYK with “{{profile}}”.

skipReasons.separationRgbAlternate: spot colour with an RGB alternate

pdfxCmyk.nothing: No RGB colour was found; nothing needed converting.
pdfxCmyk.stillRgb: What was not converted is still RGB; a check for CMYK-only output (such as PDF/X-1a) will flag it.
pdfxCmyk.growth: The file grew from {{before}} to {{after}} ({{factor}}×): converted images are stored anew and the printing profile is embedded.
